From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority rebook — tech checkpoint & next steps

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost while keeping p95 latency under 150ms for user-facing flows.
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data classification, region-restricted compute in us-west.
- Stakeholders: you (product), ops@novapulse.com, and your infra lead (TBD).

We were aiming to schedule a short technical checkpoint (15–25m) to:
1) Validate integration pattern (prefix caching + streaming),
2) Confirm model variant and quantization tolerances,
3) Align on rollout timeline and pilot metrics.

I know calendars are tight — we had a no-show on the demo invite earlier, so I pulled together two tightly-held slots where our engineering lead (Soji) and I can be fully present. Can you please pick ONE, confirm by EOD today, or let us know a concrete alternative? If we don’t hear back, we’ll queue this for Ops triage and drop the reserved runbook slot.

Proposed (both are 20 minutes, PDT):
• Wed 2027-03-10 10:30–10:50
• Thu 2027-03-11 14:00–14:20

Attached: brief discovery notes and a calendar file with both slots (attach: proposed-slots.ics).

Appreciate a quick thumbs-up — we’ll lock the slot and send an invite with a short agenda.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0139

Attachments: 2027-03-09_discovery-notes.pdf (2 pages), proposed-slots.ics (calendar invite stub)

So sorry — I had an urgent ops incident this morning and missed the original call. Thank you for the recap. Either of those times should work in principle, but I need to check Jon (our infra lead) — he’s out on a customer call until late afternoon.

I’ll confirm which slot by 3pm PT today. If Jon can’t make either, can we keep the second option (Thu 14:00) as a fallback? That one looks less likely to conflict.

—Alicia
Alicia Gomez
VP of Product, Novapulse
alicia.gomez@novapulse.com
